additional_info.body:

Thank you so much for your support during yesterday's intervention. Please be aware that the charger is working fine after modifying the LEM configuration. It is clear that the root cause of the problem is the faulty LEM and we have checked all the wiring to find any issue. As there is no fault from the LEM wiring it should be an internal fault from LEM which need to be replaced. Please proceed to replace the LEM. Thank you very much for being understanding and patient.
